subject: Important Announcement: Upcoming Website Maintenance
body: Dear valued customers, We would like to inform you that our website will undergo scheduled maintenance on Saturday, June 12th from 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM EST. During this time, you may experience temporary service disruptions. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any urgent inquiries, please feel free to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your cooperation. Best regards, The Website Team
